ad.headline: Take 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.
ad.text: Enter code SAVE20 at checkout. Limited time at Alder Trail Co.

phase: Reading the ad's promises (Muse Spark Open, open weights)

assertions.claim: Code SAVE20 gives 20% off the Ridge trail shoe
assertions.adQuote: Take 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.

phase: Following the funnel like a customer (Muse Wonder · computer use)

modelText: Checking your 20% off SAVE20 promise — I'll add the Ridge shoe to the cart and try the code at checkout.
SAVE20 gave $24 off the $120 shoe, matching 20% — I'll verify that same $96 total holds at checkout.

Checked a1: Ridge trail shoe listed at $120. Selected size 9, added 1 to cart. Applied code SAVE20 exactly as advertised. Cart showed "SAVE20 applied: -$24.00", subtotal $120.00, discount -$24.00 (20%), shipping Free, total $96.00. Checkout page confirmed the same: $120.00 subtotal, -$24.00 SAVE20, Free shipping, $96.00 total, before any payment was entered. Promise verified.

summary: Built a cart in the store's agent checkout (UCP) with the ad's codes

phase: Judging each promise against word-for-word evidence (Muse Wonder + quote check)

verdicts.adQuote: Take 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.
verdicts.reason: 20% of $120.00 is $24.00, and the website applied it, but in agent checkout SAVE20 was rejected with no discount and a $120.00 total.

fix.summary: Enable SAVE20 in agent checkout so it takes 20% ($24) off the $120 Ridge trail shoe, like the website checkout does.
fix.rationale: The website already honors SAVE20 correctly while agent checkout rejects it as not valid at $120, so the code's agent-checkout availability — not the ad — is what is broken.
steps: Store admin > Discounts > SAVE20: open the existing code.
SAVE20 > Checkout channels: enable Agent checkout, keeping 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.
SAVE20 > Status: set to Active and save.
Check via agent checkout: add the Ridge trail shoe, enter SAVE20, and confirm a $96 total with no 'not valid' message.
